title: Welcome to the CSP Blog
summary: Reflections, announcements, and essays from the Colombo School of Philosophy.
author: Colombo School of Philosophy
body: This is where we'll be sharing longer reflections, announcements, and essays that don't fit neatly into Courses or Features.
Posts here support rich formatting — italics, bold text, and links — so our writing can read the way it's meant to, not just as plain paragraphs.
Check back soon for our first real post.
